_help: Add games to this list. id = unique, no spaces. url = the page that runs the game (relative path or full link). cover = square image (optional, a colored tile is drawn if missing). icon = desktop shortcut image (optional, falls back to cover).

games.title: Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is an iconic action-adventure game where Link explores Hyrule, solves puzzles, battles enemies, explores dungeons, and uses the Ocarina of Time to travel between childhood and adulthood to stop Ganondorf.

games.title: Super Smash Bros: N64
games.description: Super Smash Bros. is a classic Nintendo 64 fighting game where players battle as iconic Nintendo characters across various stages using unique abilities, items, and powerful attacks.

games.title: Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
games.description: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask is an action-adventure game where Link explores the mysterious land of Termina, solves puzzles, battles enemies, and uses magical masks while racing against a three-day countdown to stop the moon from crashing.

games.title: Animal Forest: N64
games.description: Animal Forest is a relaxing life simulation game where players live in a peaceful village alongside animal neighbors, decorate their home, collect items, fish, catch bugs, and enjoy everyday activities.
